newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Stals happy with high S.African money mkt shortage.
newsitem.headline: Stals happy with high S.African money mkt shortage.

text.p: South African Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals said on Wednesday a high money market shortage helped the authorities keep a rein on bank credit extension and he was in no hurry to see it reduce.
"There are some advantages from a monetary policy point of view in having a money market shortage that is staying relatively high all the time," Stals told Reuters.
"It gives us a much greater influence on bank credit extension and the money supply. We are in no hurry to try and reduce the shortage."
South Africa's money market shortage rose to 10.664 billion rand on Tuesday from Monday's 10.446 billion rand.
Leading banks continued to quote their three-month NCD rates steady on Wednesday at between 17.25-17.50 percent while 90-day BA rates were also unchanged at 16.60-16.85 percent.
